summary.result: Overall, the wetland system was found to be satisfactory for NPS control such as improvement of polluted stream water.
summary.background: Wetland systems are widely accepted natural water purification systems around the world in nonpoint sources pollution control.
summary.method: In this study, the field experiment to reduce nonpoint source pollution loadings from polluted stream waters using wetland system was performed from June 2002 to March 2004, including winter performance using four newly constructed wetlands.
